tasks.title: iOS Safari zooms in when typing in any input; keep screen fixed like WhatsApp everywhere
tasks.brief: Ahmed (iPhone Safari, screenshot): tapping the conversations composer makes the page zoom in and the layout shifts; he wants the screen to stay exactly like WhatsApp when typing, and the same in EVERY input across the whole app (search, sale, barcode, PIN, settings, returns, forms). Root cause: iOS auto-zooms inputs/textarea/select with computed font-size < 16px. Fix globally: all input/textarea/select font-size >= 16px on touch devices (keep visual design, adjust padding), viewport meta with width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover, interactive-widget=resizes-content (do NOT disable user pinch zoom unless needed for accessibility review; prefer the 16px fix). Conversations: composer pinned above the keyboard (visualViewport / dvh), message list stays scrolled to bottom, header stays visible, no page jump, like WhatsApp. Add a Playwright WebKit iPhone test asserting every input's computed font-size >= 16px and no scale change on focus. Build the next free worker/live artifact (tools/build-worker-artifact.mjs, markers test, node --check). No deploy.
tasks.acceptance: No zoom on focus in any input on iPhone; composer stays above keyboard like WhatsApp; test covers all inputs; artifact built; no deploy.
